architecture.mechanism: Offset-free explicit model predictive control with disturbance estimator to reject torque loss and regulate idle speed under system delay
architecture.intervention: Upgrade the engine's idle air control algorithm from a standard PI/PID loop to an offset-free MPC scheme that explicitly estimates and compensates for unmeasured disturbances (torque loss) and accounts for intake-to-torque delay.
architecture.expected_effect: Stable idle speed at low RPMs and cold conditions, elimination of intermittent misfire-induced stalling, and reduced sensitivity to sensor noise or delay.
architecture.falsification_test: Introduce a simulated torque loss disturbance (equivalent to a misfire) and a communication delay; if the ISC maintains target idle speed within a defined tolerance (e.g., ±100 RPM) without oscillation, the mechanism holds; if it stalls or drifts significantly, it fails.
